browser.limitations: Finite seven-second loader observation, not proof of infinite duration. Automated browser gestures are not a genuine human Switch message or approval. Only the declared nullable-array union is covered, not arbitrary JSON Schema unions.

executionBoundary.scope: Read-only source/dependency snapshots for canonical and targeted upstream Jest processes. Not complete worker/build/browser isolation.

limitations: Canonical/regression Jest execution is isolated. Builds, HTTP/browser control and the trusted coordinator remain host processes; not complete worker/environment isolation or permission to merge/deploy/publish/submit.

review.scope: Local tested bundle review only; no production or public action
